title: Zac Brown Band Live 2026: Here’s Where to Watch the Red Rocks Concert Series Live Online
summary: The country band is set to play two concerts live at Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre in Colorado — livestream at home.
contentText:

This fall, Atlanta-based rock band Zac Brown Band is on the Love & Fear tour throughout the Midwest, East Coast and Mountain West. This week, the band is set to perform a two-concert series live at Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre in Morrison, Colorado.
